lines: Outside too — how would it not happen?
From drawing without practice, if asked:
l4.sanskrit_cite: bahir api itthaṃ kathaṃ na bhavati ākarṣaṇādau vinābhyāsāt iti cet rāgadveṣādiyogavaśena tatpravṛttau aiśvaryāveśāyogāt

reads_against.argmap: Why does the outside case not behave the same? → The outside fails without abhyāsa — its operation runs on rāga-dveṣa-yoga-vaśa, not on the aiśvarya-immersion that inner drawing has.
